Welcome to your home away from home! Churchill Dunes is a 5 bedroom, 3.5 bath luxury home just off scenic Hwy 30A in Inlet Beach. With over 2600sqft of living space, this picturesque beach home features upscale décor and high-end finishes, including custom reclaimed oak hardwood flooring throughout! On the first floor you'll find three bedrooms including a bunk room, laundry room, and access to the one-car garage. The main living area and a chef's dream kitchen is found on the second floor which has impact-rated sliding glass doors that showcase endless emerald green ocean views. You'll also find the master suite on the second floor which boosts a large walk-in closet, a rainfall shower head in the large walk-in shower, and access to a private balcony which is the perfect spot for your morning cup of coffee. On the third floor, secluded enough to be a bedroom is an additional living area and two sets of hand-crafted bunk beds, and access to another balcony to view those vibrant Florida sunsets. With private beach access, a sparkling community pool, and world-class dining and shopping nearby, Churchill Dunes is the perfect vacation destination for your family for years to come!

*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.*

Barbary Coast Development of Inlet Beach is located just steps away from the emerald water of 30A. Nestled on the east end of 30A near Rosemary Beach, this exclusive community is a short bike ride to fine dining, shopping and year-round family fun at the new 30Avenue development. The Barbary Coast Development offers a private community pool and a private walkway to the white sand within a few steps of the home.

Area Attractions:

Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike, and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach.

Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!

The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!

responses.response: Sarah, Thank you for taking the time to review your stay. We are truly sorry for all of the issues you experienced. We would like you to know that the listing has been updated to accurately reflect the sleeping arrangements. Patio furniture has been ordered as well as a part for the dishwasher which is why we could not fix it while you were there. We appreciate your ability to laugh at the situation and not let it ruin your vacation. We're glad you enjoyed being close to the beach and the pool. Thank you for choosing RealJoy.

reviews.text: Churchill Dunes is nestled perfectly between a neighborhood pool and beach access, with easy access to Rosemary, 30A, and Highway 98. We could not have asked for a better location and it is a beautiful home - from afar. The listing claimed two king bedrooms when we booked, but there was actually only one. That caused some commotion as someone inevitably was disappointed. I requested all listings on all platforms be amended. We were some of the first guests since this ownership team took over, and it's clear there were some kinks to work out. There was mold covering the interior dishwasher to the point that we didn't trust the cleanliness of the dishes. The primary shower drain was clogged. When a repairman came in on Day 3, he assured us that someone would return the next day and suggested we hand wash all of our dishes for our health and safety. No one ever returned. We bought a poster board to cover the downstairs bathroom window so neighbors couldn't see in. There was no hair dryer, even though it was listed as included. The stairway light switch didn't work. The only mirrors are in the bathrooms, making it difficult for many folks to get ready at the same time. I think there was one towel hook in the house. Three of the four patio/balcony areas had no furniture. We laughed about the circumstances and enjoyed being so close to the beach and pool. Hopefully, the next folks will benefit from our comedy of errors.
reviews.title: Working out the kinks
